description: Sign out of Brightspace on this computer: delete the saved Brightspace session, so every Brightspace app here must sign in again from scratch on its next question. Keeps the saved password, settings, and authenticator key. Does not sign out of Microsoft or Brightspace on other devices. Call this ONLY when the user explicitly asks to sign out or log out of Brightspace (a shared computer, handing the machine on). Never call it to fix an error, never as part of answering another question, and never to retry or refresh a sign-in.
name: sign_out
title: Sign Out of Brightspace
